info.name: SkillBridge API (Week 3)
info.description:
Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner works). Demo accounts are seeded dummy data. Use a fresh database for a clean pass.

FRESH DATABASE REQUIRED: folders 3 to 6 assume the seed data only. After one full run, a second run fails on purpose-built rules (ALREADY_VERIFIED, ALREADY_APPLIED). Reset with: docker compose down -v, then docker compose up -d. This deletes the local demo data and Flyway re-creates and re-seeds it.

Week 3: folder 7 checks pagination. Rate limit: POST /api/auth/* allows 20 requests per 60 seconds per address; if you re-run folder 1 many times in a minute you will get 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS with Retry-After.

request.description: Docker BEGINNER is verified (met). Java is only verified at BEGINNER, below INTERMEDIATE (not met). The percentage is rounded down.

exec: pm.test('1 of 2 requirements, 50 percent', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.requirementsMet).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.totalRequirements).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.matchPercentage).to.eql(50); });

7 Pagination (Week 3)
item.description: Checks paging on every list endpoint: page and size, X-Total-Count, past-the-end page, and the 400 cases. Run folder 1 (Auth) first so the tokens are set. None of these requests call /api/auth/*, so they never count towards the rate limit (20 per 60 s per address on POST /api/auth/*).

exec: pm.test('X-Total-Count header is a number', function () { pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-Total-Count'))).to.be.a('number').and.not.NaN; });
pm.test('total is at least the rows returned', function () { pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-Total-Count'))).to.be.at.least(pm.response.json().length); });
